name: y3d
description: Y3D - a direct NURBS/B-rep CAD modeler for Linux (Electron + Three.js + OpenCascade)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.smoke:half: npm run build && Y3D_SMOKE=/tmp/y3d-smoke Y3D_SMOKE_HALF=1 electron .
scripts.bench: npm run build && Y3D_STRESS=${N:-2000} Y3D_BENCH=1 electron .
